description: This PHP source file defines the class WriteRequestBatch, which manages batch write operations (put and delete requests) to AWS DynamoDB. It handles batching, queuing, auto-flushing, and re-queuing unprocessed items, encapsulating the logic for efficient batch writes with retry mechanisms.

classes.name: WriteRequestBatch
classes.description: Manages batching, queuing, and executing batch write requests to DynamoDB, including handling unprocessed items and auto-flushing based on configured thresholds.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the batch with a DynamoDbClient, configuration options, and sets up internal queues and defaults.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a put request for an item into the batch queue, with optional table override.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds a delete request for a key into the batch queue, with optional table override.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Sends queued requests to DynamoDB as batch write operations, retrying unprocessed items until the queue is empty or until specified.

methods.name: prepareCommands
methods.description: Prepares and creates command objects for batch write requests based on current queue contents.

methods.name: retryUnprocessed
methods.description: Re-queues any unprocessed items returned from DynamoDB for later retry.

methods.name: autoFlush
methods.description: Automatically flushes the batch if the queue size exceeds the threshold, respecting the autoflush setting.

methods.name: determineTable
methods.description: Determines the target table name based on argument or default configuration, throws if not specified.
